purpose: r5-e02-blast-radius: studio experiment E02, the blast radius: one example agent's grant rows, the mandate a small core, the excess around it, from the researcher's capture of abp.sgit.ai

request.text: One sentence the audience must understand: if one agent inside the company goes wrong, the damage reaches everything its grant reaches, and the grant is far larger than what it is for. The data: only src/static/studio/data/abp-examples.json. Draw from the grant rows, not from totals. The main example is the Claude Code CLI: grant 16, mandate 5, excess 12. Draw the shortfall too: one mandate item, send.endpoint.allowed, is not in the grant, so the excess is 16 minus the 4 granted mandate items. Label every example a published draft: none of the Claude Code rows is measured. What moves: start where E01's v2 ends, the model with its reach shaded. Then turn the shading into rows: each capability it can reach placed by how far it is from what the agent is for. The mandate lights up as a small core; the excess around it is the blast radius. Then, optionally, the barrier kind on each excess row. Length: 40 to 60 seconds; must read as a still at the end. What it must not say: no risk score or level; no product logos; no number that is not in the file; never 'measured' for these rows. An explainer beside it, as E01's.

ending: keep or delete: the editor's call after review
